scope: Neutral-path lever A/B screen on the ordinary physical GPU; readback on, timer off; not formal capacity acceptance.
head: 1474316d2bfd38809c38a1e6050c29d83351e369

gate.submit_improvement: submit median improves by at least 10 percent at both (1800, render-only) and (2600, render-only)
gate.cycle_non_regression: cycle median and cycle p99 median regress by at most 5 percent in every gate cell
gate.repeatability: per cell and arm, (max-min)/median of the process medians is at most 15 percent for submit and cycle
gate.value_identity: every process reports 255,204,51,255 with draws and in-view centers equal to the entity count, and both arms agree
gate.stop: an invalid process stops the group; no retry, no replacement, no extra samples

skipped.name: Secure file rejects physical containment escapes through symlinks

release_suite.console_note: The console stream archived beside the journal starts at test 335 of 1418 because the job buffer dropped the earlier lines. Nothing was reconstructed: the journal holds every test block, and the console tail holds the final tally, the wall time, the skipped list and the exit marker verbatim. The format target was re-run by this builder, so its transcript and return code are recorded by the same run that froze the archive.

limitation: One group on one physical GPU with pixel readback enabled on both arms, so the absolute times are readback-inclusive and are not frontier points. The 40000 cell exists to show the lever still acts at stress scale; it gates nothing.
